mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND is_active = true

SELECT id, employee_number, name, department_id, role, position_rank FROM users WHERE is_active = true
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR employee_number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND department_id = #{departmentId}
LIMIT 50
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (employee_number, name, department_id, role, position_rank, email, phone, hire_date, contract_type, is_active, resigned_at) VALUES (#{employeeNumber}, #{name}, #{departmentId}, #{role}, #{positionRank}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{hireDate}, #{contractType}, #{active}, #{resignedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET name = #{name}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
